prompt: Make one photorealistically crisp, full-fidelity web application SCREENSHOT (not a laptop mockup, no browser chrome, no presentation frame), 1440x900 desktop landscape. Application: Camba, the owner-facing clothing store admin, Producto catalog screen. Visual direction "Mesa de catálogo": contemporary quiet gallery inventory, warm off-white #F7F6F2 page, near-black olive ink #242820, muted forest #264F3D for primary action, muted rust only for issue signals and textual status, fine cool-neutral lines, precise contemporary sans type, spacious Apple-inspired clarity without Apple assets. Semantic low-chrome design, accessible contrast, full readable controls. No promotions, discounts, invented performance claims or KPI tiles. Use concise Spanish behavior words exactly: Camba, Productos, Pedidos, Configuración, Nuevo producto, Buscar por nombre o SKU, Categoría, Estado, Borrador, Publicado, Archivado. Show accurate example-only list items (Camisa de algodón, Remera lisa, Pantalón recto), tiny neutral cloth silhouette thumbnails, prices as UYU; small "Datos de ejemplo" note at bottom, not actual product claims. Use only necessary navigation (3), title (1), filters (3), short single primary CTA. Include ready, draft and issues visually without relying on color alone. Plain design without illustrative textures, effects or gradients; raster only for actual thumbnails. Preserve a readable grid on desktop. Structure: horizontal wordmark/navigation compact wide header; task area split horizontally into a 75-percent single working table and a 25-percent narrow right rail only for unresolved drafts and active issue note displayed as 2–3 compact calls to action. Explicit attention to consistent simple navigation and one CTA. Use horizontally aligned tabs Todos, Borradores, Publicados right above working table, not nested lists. Keep one strong title, rows clean and most work visible at a glance; no charts or summary cards.
